description: This file defines the NotesListActivity which displays a list of notes, allows user interactions such as creating a new note, and manages presenting and updating the notes list within an Android application.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of notes with diffing capabilities.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder that binds individual note data to the item view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes views, sets up RecyclerView, and observes the ViewModel for note data.

methods.name: updateEmptyState
methods.description: Updates UI visibility based on whether the notes list is empty.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for note items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the view elements.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates note content to a specified limit, appending an ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.
